title: Plate Stack Marriage Test
north_star: A small dinner-table joke that feels like real married life: two people comfortable enough to try tiny shortcuts and counter them without turning it into a lesson.
human_truth: Marriage does not magically make one person the responsible one. Sometimes it just gives both people better timing for the same tiny laziness.
emotional_arc: ordinary dinner -> honest kitchen instinct -> tiny lazy idea -> silent handoff -> deadpan read -> plate-stack reversal -> kitchen consequence
public_copy_direction: Low-text, scene-first, deadpan, Hinglish only where it sounds like a real thought or speech bubble.

creator_correction_applied.summary: Zuv does not ask Aachu to keep his plate. He casually/silently hands or slides his plate to her because she is also done. Aachu stacks her plate on his, says `dono rakh do.`, then starts using her phone.

taste_guardrails: Both partners should feel active, funny, and human.
